{{Quote|Our Adarian-style donuts are made fresh daily by a genuine Crisp-E-O donut droid. Bright and early every morning, our Crisp-E-O unit sorts through its database of more than 2,400 donut recipes to choose the delicious varieties to be made that day using its internal oil fryer. You never know when you'll discover a new favorite. (If you get the chance, be sure to try the dianoga cream-filled donut--it's divine!)|Dex's Diner menu, on its donuts|<ref name="Menu" />}}
A '''dianoga cream-filled donut''' was an [[Adarian-style donut]] that contained [[dianoga cream]].<ref name="Menu" /> It shared its name with a large [[Limb/Legends|tenticled]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]].<ref name="Wildlife guide">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>A recipe for the [[Doughnut/Legends|donut]] was contained in the database of the [[Crisp-E-O donut droid]] that worked at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Every [[Local day/Legends|day]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] would choose a selection of donuts from its over 2,400 donut recipes to serve at the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]]. The diner's menu contained a personal recommendation for the donut from the [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], the diner's [[Chef/Legends|chef]] who referred to dianoga cream-filled donuts as "divine."<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dianoga cream-filled donuts were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
